description: # Computer Science. ## COMPUTER SCIENCE 170—INTRODUCTION TO COMPUTER SCIENCE I (QR). An introduction to computer science for the student who needs to be able to program for coursework or research. Topics include: fundamental computing concepts, general programming principles, and the Java programming language. Emphasis will be on algorithm development with examples highlighting topics in data structures. Emphasis is on the use and implementation of data structures, fundamental algorithms with introductory algorithm analysis, and object-oriented design and programming with Java. ## COMPUTER SCIENCE 224—FOUNDATIONS OF COMPUTER SCIENCE (QR). ## COMPUTER SCIENCE 253—DATA STRUCTURES AND ALGORITHMS (QR). A third course in Computer Science, focusing on advanced programming. Emphasis is on mastery in the use and implementation of data structures and algorithms for classical programming paradigms, using the Java programming language and object-oriented design. ## COMPUTER SCIENCE 255—COMPUTER ARCHITECTURE/MACHINE LEVEL PROGRAMMING (QR). Introductory systems course in Computer Science, with a focus on high-level computer architecture and assembler programming.
